content: Skill sets are created by room admins. When someone invites you to one, it appears here.

comment.text: Description on the empty screen of the Skill sets list in the AI Chat section for a user who cannot create one: who creates them, and that an invitation makes one appear here. Room admin is a user role. Terms: agent = an AI assistant set up with a model, skill sets and knowledge bases; skill set = a room of skills (Markdown instructions); knowledge base = a room of files the assistant searches. Match Common:Agents, Common:SkillSets, Common:AIProjectKnowledgeRooms.
